contentPattern: Row 1 (optional, 1 cell): heading 'Filter by Deployment'. Rows 2-4 (2 cells): label (SaaS / All / Self-Hosted) | sub-label (We host it (choice of regions) / Products & Tools / You host it (local servers or cloud)). The label is the filter key matched against the Deployment cell of product rows and tool cards; 'All' shows everything and is selected by default (author can mark the default in bold).
